$comment: Accepted advisories for ghcr.io/eanfs/multica-runtime-node. Each entry is a Debian bookworm base-image advisory that no Aurora change can fix: the package is the distribution's, the version is what the pinned base ships, and the image is the node image. The release policy blocks CRITICAL unless an entry matches; secrets always block and HIGH findings stay advisory. Remove an entry when the base or package moves past it, and review the set with the owner before the first publish.
